title: 3 BHK Flat in Semal Heights, Sector 82 Mohali
description: An east-facing three-bedroom residence on the ninth floor of Semal Heights, the high-rise society taking shape off Airport Road in Sector 82. The plan puts the living and dining in one long room that opens onto a deep balcony, with the kitchen and a utility area kept to one side. All three bedrooms have attached bathrooms, and the master looks out over the central lawns. Chandigarh International Airport is about fifteen minutes away, and the IT City and Aerocity offices are closer still. The tower is under construction; the unit is offered from the builder's current inventory, and our team can walk you through the floor plans and the construction schedule on site.

title: 4 BHK Flat in Semal Heights, Sector 82 Mohali
description: A four-bedroom corner apartment on an upper floor of Semal Heights, with windows on two sides and a wraparound balcony facing the park. The layout separates a formal living room from a family lounge, and the fourth bedroom works as a study or a guest room with its own bathroom. A separate servant room and a utility balcony sit off the kitchen. The society is planned around a clubhouse, pool and landscaped courts, a short drive from the airport, the IT City and the schools along Airport Road. Construction is underway; we can share the plan, specifications and the current progress at the site office.

title: 2 BHK Flat in Kachnar Township, Peer Muchalla Zirakpur
description: A ready-to-move two-bedroom flat in Kachnar Township, a gated society in Peer Muchalla with the Panchkula border a few minutes away. The apartment is on the fourth floor, with a bright living room, a modular kitchen and two bedrooms that share a well-lit common bathroom alongside the attached one. Wardrobes and fans are already in place, so it suits a first home or a rental. Daily shopping, schools and the Zirakpur–Panchkula road are close by, and the township has its own park, power backup and round-the-clock security.

description: A three-bedroom, ready-to-move home in Kachnar Township that looks over the society's central green. The living and dining area opens onto a balcony running the width of the room, and the kitchen has space for a breakfast counter. Each bedroom has its own bathroom, and the master includes a dressing area. The flat is on the second floor, so the lift is a convenience rather than a necessity. Peer Muchalla keeps you close to both Panchkula and the Zirakpur market, with the Chandigarh border about ten minutes away.

The home has a living room with a separate dining nook, a modular kitchen, and three bedrooms with two attached bathrooms. The owners have maintained it carefully, with fresh paint and new fittings in the kitchen. Schools, the Sector 70 market and the Phase 3B2 market are all within a short drive, and the Airport Road is about ten minutes away.

description: A two-bedroom apartment in a high-rise on Zirakpur's VIP Road, with Chandigarh, the airport and the Ambala highway all within easy reach. The living room opens onto a balcony with an open view, and both bedrooms have attached bathrooms. The kitchen is fitted with cabinets and a chimney. The society has lifts, power backup and security at the gate, and the VIP Road stretch has cafés, supermarkets and schools a few minutes' walk away. A practical home, or a steady rental for professionals working in the Tricity.

Aerocity's wide roads and green belts keep the area quiet, and the airport, the IT City and the PR-7 road connect you across the Tricity in minutes.

The double-height living room is the centrepiece, with a separate family lounge, a formal dining space and a kitchen finished in stone. Four bedrooms each have their own bathroom, and a staff room sits beside the service entrance. The terrace is large enough for a garden and evening gatherings. Sector 66 is minutes from the airport road, the IT City and the international cricket stadium.

It is an independent floor with its own entrance and stilt parking below, so there are no society charges to speak of. The living room faces the front and gets good light through the day; the kitchen is modular, and all three bedrooms have attached bathrooms. Dhakoli has everyday shopping, schools and the Zirakpur–Panchkula road close at hand.

The sector is green and quiet, with markets, schools and the Panchkula–Chandigarh road within a few minutes.

description: A two-storey kothi on a one-kanal plot in Sector 8, among Chandigarh's most sought-after northern sectors, a short walk from the Sector 8 market and the leisure valley. The house was rebuilt a few years ago with a contemporary front, and it keeps the generous proportions of the original: a formal drawing room, a family lounge, five bedrooms with attached bathrooms and a terrace on the upper floor. A front lawn and a covered porch complete the plot. Sukhna Lake, the Rock Garden and the city's best schools are minutes away.
